rawPackedMaterial: Each8B texel: original native BGRA8 bytes first4, remaining4 zero. Offline global native4-neighborYCoCg decode before semantic mips.
materialTransfer: decoded linear RGB, gloss A, IEEE754 little-endian binary16; no sRGB/gamma/clamp
normalTransfer: world XYZ*0.5+0.5 UNORM8; explicit coverage UNORM8 A
heightTransfer: IEEE754 little-endian float32 absolute world Y
invalid: nonfinite material/height or zero coverage => material0, normal(128,255,128), coverage0, height0
readyManifest: ready.json; atomic same-directory no-overwrite rename after all16 headers/plane digests complete
